en: A black-and-white photograph of a two-story building with a tiled roof, likely a small railway station. There is a sign reading 'SKÄLDERVIKEN' above a clock, as well as another sign below the image that reads 'SKÄLDERVIKEN Järnvägsstationen'. Several bicycles are visible, along with a person sitting on a bench in the foreground and another person standing near the entrance. The building is adorned with flowers and climbing plants.
